verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents its own Memory Export feature, which creates structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas. An open-source, self-hostable engine where 'you own the stack, the data' also supports leaving the hosted Platform. However, the evidence never states the export format is open (e.g., JSON or CSV), nor that export covers all account data rather than schema-shaped memory extracts. Missing for 10: explicit open-format output (JSON/CSV) for exports, evidence that export covers all data (memories, graph, metadata), a documented Platform-to-self-host migration path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
